priorIterationResolution.priorFinding: FIND-022 (iteration-9, critical -- exact-string caption match untested against IG's real truncation/rendering behavior, risking false negatives)
priorIterationResolution.note: The narrow original concern (exact full-string equality false-negatives against IG's own '...more' truncation) is addressed at the behavioral-spec.md prose level: REQ-008 step 6 (lines 224-238) redesigns the check to a 40-character whitespace-normalized SUBSTRING containment test, with whitespace normalization explicitly applied to BOTH the match_key and the page's innerText (closing the asymmetric-normalization ambiguity a prior reviewer might have raised). PROP-006(a)'s truncation regression test is concretely specified. HOWEVER this fix is not fully trustworthy as shipped: (1) it directly contradicts verification-architecture.md's own purity-boundary-table description of select_confirmed_href, which still says the function returns the href whose caption 'exactly matches' -- see FIND-024 (critical); (2) the substring design's own safety rationale (distinct clips have distinct captions) is contradicted by this project's own documented clone-the-hook content strategy -- see FIND-025 (critical); (3) the one live/real E2E proof obligation (PROP-008) still never exercises this path at all, an evidence gap iteration-9 already raised and which remains completely open -- see FIND-026 (critical). The original narrow finding's symptom is fixed; the fix itself introduces or leaves open more severe problems.

PROP-010 (verification-architecture.md line 81) adds a concrete test: select_confirmed_href(['/A/','/B/'], {'/A/': 'the money hook #ai', '/B/': 'the money hook #ai'}, 'the money hook #ai') asserts a return of None, explicitly targeting the exact naive next()-based implementation bug this finding warned about. Combined with the existing 0-match and 1-match tests (referenced correctly), this gives genuine 3-way branch coverage for the function's own documented contract. The Tier-1 legend (verification-architecture.md line 88) also now lists select_confirmed_href, closing the legend-omission half of FIND-023. This finding is soundly closed.
